test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c2013dd475e8aaf1526f7b9d932cc135e9e6bf950a67cf82a5c0b6682d688c1.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Square figure is shifted on the right upper side in the second figure and the black part is one step backward, then shifted middle of the bottom, and the black part is shifted one step backward, then finally shifted left upper corner and the black part shifted one step backward.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c58705fd4cc3bba2eb6e73f56d5788a4d203bc0789d60fee555564ec2b44d27a.png] 

2) Pentagon figure is rotated 90º degrees anticlockwise direction in every next figure, first shifted middle of the bottom, then shifted left upper corner, then shifted right upper corner in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02d48174da24cd042645dbbc96d99c0ea9ccc78dbb1f73deb08a7836ce031f0e.png] 

3) Here shape rotate 90º degrees anticlockwise direction in every next figure, first shifted right upper corner in second figure, then shifted left upper corner in the second figure, then shifted middle of the figure in the bottom side in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e35a8285716d701cc9e99b57de03f3a41d9ea0bbc9fc9647cd13592930a440d9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
